## Introductory

Hi, I’m Chuyuan Xu — an MPH student in the Biostatistics department at Mailman School of Public Health, Columbia University, with a focus on health research and data science.<br>
My work focuses on applying statistical modeling and data analysis to understand complex public health problems, including mental health disparities and environmental health risks. I have experience with regression modeling, structural equation modeling, survival analysis, and large-scale datasets in R and SAS.<br>
I’m particularly interested in translating cold data into meaningful, approachable insights that inform research and public health practice. Feel free to explore my projects below or reach out to discuss collaboration.


<br>
